title: THERAPUETIC ULTRASOUND SYSTEM USING OVERLAPPING FOCAL VOLUMES
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for focused ultrasound neuromodulation. A first phased array ultrasound transducer is positioned within a fixation device to provide a first ultrasound beam through the ultrasound temporal window of a patient with a first focal volume within a region of interest. A second phased array ultrasound transducer is positioned within the fixation device to provide a second ultrasound beam through one of a frontal bone, a parietal bone, a sagittal suture, or a coronal suture of the patient with a second focal volume within a region of interest. A signal dose within each of the focal volumes is less than a threshold dose. A system control controls each of the ultrasound transducers such that the focal volumes overlap as to collectively provide a signal dose within a region of overlap in the region of interest that is not less than the threshold dose.
first_claim: 1. A system comprising: a fixation device; a first phased array ultrasound transducer positioned within the fixation device to provide a first ultrasound beam through a temporal ultrasound window of a patient with a first focal volume within a region of interest, a signal dose within the first focal volume being less than a threshold dose associated with therapeutic efficacy; a second phased array ultrasound transducer that is positioned within the fixation device to provide a second ultrasound beam through one of a frontal bone, a parietal bone, a sagittal suture, or a coronal suture of the patient with a second focal volume within a region of interest, a signal dose within the second focal volume being less than the threshold dose; and a system control that controls each of the first phased array ultrasound transducer and the second phased array ultrasound transducer such that the first focal volume overlaps with the second focal volume as to collectively provide a signal dose within a region of overlap in the region of interest that is not less than the threshold dose.
assignees: West Virginia University Board of Governors on behalf of West Virginia University

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR CLOSED-LOOP NEUROMODULATION USING MULTIPLE BIOLOGICAL SIGNALS
abstract: Neuromodulation devices and methods configured to supply electrical stimulation to a subject based on the one or more biological signals obtained by one or more sensors. These apparatuses may be configured to transmit more than 90% of the time, with limited and prescribed receiving capability.
first_claim: 1.-45. (canceled)
assignees: The Feinstein Institutes for Medical Research

title: Deep brain stimulation transparent electrode array and neural signal detection method using same
abstract: A deep brain stimulation transparent electrode array and a neural signal detection method using the same are proposed. The deep brain stimulation transparent electrode array includes a biocompatible dielectric substrate, a plurality of electrode sites arranged on one side of the substrate, a plurality of electrically conductive contacts arranged on the other side of the substrate, and an interconnector extended from each electrode site so as to be connected to each contact. The deep brain stimulation transparent electrode array is capable of conducting deep brain electrical stimulation and brain wave detection while minimizing image distortion in magnetic resonance imaging, and accuracy of the deep brain electrical stimulation and the brain wave detection may be increased by enhancing ability to carry electric current and minimizing the image distortion in the magnetic resonance imaging.
first_claim: 1. A deep brain stimulation transparent electrode array comprising: an optically transparent biocompatible dielectric substrate; a plurality of electrode sites disposed on one side of the biocompatible dielectric substrate; a plurality of electrically conductive contacts disposed on another side of the biocompatible dielectric substrate; an interconnector extending from the plurality of electrode sites and connecting the plurality of electrically conductive contacts and the plurality of electrode; and an optical fiber bonded to an underside of the biocompatible dielectric substrate and configured to deliver optical stimulation and perform optical sensing, wherein each of the plurality of electrode sites is made of a metal material, and the interconnector is made of a carbon material in a form of one to ten layers of graphene sheets, and wherein a length of one end of the biocompatible dielectric substrate is longer than a length of one end of the optical fiber, and the one end of the biocompatible dielectric substrate is folded toward the one end of the optical fiber, so that a part or all of each of the plurality of electrode sites covers the one end of the optical fiber and so that light is configured to pass around the electrode sites and through the substrate to and/or from the optical fiber.
assignees: University of Seoul Industry Cooperation Foundation

title: Method and apparatus for brain function enhancement
abstract: In one aspect, a system for in vivo and transcranial stimulation of brain tissue of a subject may include at least one light source, a controller to control operation of the light source, a signal detecting unit and a processor configured to receive signals from the signal detecting unit, analyze the signals and generate a feedback signal to the controller to control the light source until optimal results are obtained. In one embodiment, the light source is a laser instrument and the wavelength can range from 800 to 1100 nm. In another embodiment, the irradiance of the laser instrument can range from 50 to 1000 mW/cm2.
first_claim: 1. A system for in vivo and transcranial stimulation of brain tissue of a subject comprising at least one light source; a controller to control operation of the light source; a signal detecting unit and a processor configured to receive a signal from the signal detecting unit; analyze the signal and generate a feedback signal to the controller to control the light source until predetermined results are obtained, wherein the system further includes a reflection module to receiving a light beam from said light source and having one or more sets of mirrors configured to generate one or more light beams and reflect the light beams to the subject's brain tissue, wherein the processor includes a calculation module to control the mirrors in the reflection module and the light beam of the light source according to the analyzed results and the structure of the head of the subject, and wherein calculation module is configured to calculate photon paths of the light beam and perform an inverse calculation in order to decide required shape, energy, power, duration and wavelengths of the light beam.

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR BRAIN STATE STIMULATION
abstract: The present disclosure provides systems and methods for predicting and treating a neurological behavior in a subject. The system may include a plurality of electrodes configured to receive electrical activity signals from a network of two or more regions of the subject's brain and a controller in communication with the plurality of electrodes. The system may be configured to receive and record the electrical activity signals from the plurality of electrodes, provide the electrical activity signals to the controller, generate a prediction of a time of onset of the neurological behavior, and send a stimulation signal to the brain prior to the predicted time of onset of the neurological behavior. The stimulation signal to the brain may suppress the neurological behavior.
first_claim: 1. A system for predicting and treating a neurological behavior in a subject comprising: a plurality of electrodes configured to receive electrical activity signals from a network of two or more regions of the subject's brain; and a controller in communication with the plurality of electrodes, the controller having at least one processor in communication with a memory, the memory including instructions executable by the processor to: receive and record the electrical activity signals from the plurality of electrodes; generate a prediction of a time of onset of the neurological behavior from the electrical activity signals; and send a stimulation signal to the brain prior to the predicted time of onset of the neurological behavior, wherein the stimulation signal to the brain suppresses the neurological behavior.

title: ENGAGEMENT COMPONENT SELECTION FOR CONTROL OF BIO-PSYCHIATRIC THERAPEUTIC TRAJECTORY (BTT)
abstract: Methods, devices, and systems are described for closed-loop neuromodulation for control of a physiological state. The system includes an energy application system, a user device, a sensor, and a controller. The controller may be configured to select a state phase based on an engagement component. The controller may be configured to prompt at least one of the user device to present a cue to the subject or the energy application system to apply the electrical stimulation to the subject based on the selected state phase. The controller may be configured to measure the set of physiological reactions induced by the selected state phase. The controller may determine a subject bio-psychiatric therapeutic trajectory based on the measured set of physiological reactions from the subject, the subject bio-psychiatric therapeutic trajectory generated by mapping the set of physiological reactions from the subject to the state phase.
first_claim: 1. A system comprising: an energy application system configured to disturb an electrical activity in a subject head of a subject for inducing a physiological reaction in the subject, the energy application system having at least a first energy-emitting device and a second energy-emitting device configured to have a voltage difference across the subject head for disturbing the electrical activity; a sensor configured to couple to the subject to detect at least one feature of the physiological reaction of the subject; and a controller communicatively coupled to the energy application system and the sensor, the controller configured to: selecting a first state phase from a set of state phases based on an engagement component, the engagement component having a set of state phases and determinative of the state phase from the set of state phases, the set of state phases associated with stimulation parameters applied by the energy application system, the state phases configured to induce a set of physiological reactions from the subject measurable by the sensor, the first state phase having a first set of stimulation parameters to be presented alongside a first cue; measure, in response to prompting the energy application system to apply the first set of stimulation parameters representative of the selected first state phase from the set of state phases to the subject head, an unsatisfying physiological reaction from the subject using the sensor, the unsatisfying physiological reaction being induced by the energy application system coupled to the subject head, the unsatisfying physiological reaction failing to satisfy an expected physiological reaction threshold indicative of a healthy physiological reaction by a healthy individual; prompt, in response to measuring the unsatisfying physiological reaction from the subject using the sensor, the energy application system to select a next state phase from the set of state phases based on the engagement component, the next state phase having a second set of stimulation parameters to be presented alongside a second set of cues; measure, in response to prompting the energy application system to apply the second set of stimulation parameters representative of the selected next state phase from the set of state phases to the subject head, a second physiological reaction of the subject using the sensor, the second physiological reaction induced by the next state phase; and identify a subject bio-psychiatric therapeutic trajectory based on the second physiological reaction from the subject and the unsatisfying physiological reaction from the subject, the subject bio-psychiatric therapeutic trajectory generated by mapping the second physiological reaction from the subject to the next state phase, the subject bio-psychiatric therapeutic trajectory being indicative of a physiological state pattern or a cognitive state of the subject corresponding to the engagement component.
assignees: The City University of New York

title: Systems and methods for generic control using a neural signal
abstract: Universal switch modules, universal switches, and methods of using the same are disclosed, including haptic confirmation of commands generated by the user, methods of preparing an individual to interface with an electronic device or software.
first_claim: 1. A method for interfacing an individual having a brain computer interface configured to control one or more electronic devices, the method comprising: measuring neural-related signals of the individual using a neural implant to obtain a first sensed neural signal when the individual generates a first thought associated with motor intent; and transmitting the first sensed neural signal to a processing unit, where the processing unit 1) associates the first sensed neural signal with a first input command independent of the one or more electronic devices and 2) provides a user feedback confirmation that allows the individual to experience confirmation that the brain computer interface is recognizing the first thought associated with the motor intent; wherein after the processing unit associates the first sensed neural signal with the first input command and provides the user feedback confirmation, the processing unit transmits the first input command to a first electronic device to cause the first electronic device to issue an output command previously associated with the first input command, where the output command causes the first electronic device to take an action.

title: Neuromodulation and other therapies to treat a combination of obstructive sleep apnea and central sleep apnea
abstract: The present disclosure generally relates to systems and methods for stimulating the hypoglossal nerve (HGN) and phrenic nerve (PN) to treat OSA and CSA for a subject. The system includes an implantable pulse generator (IPG) coupled to a first electrode and a second electrode, where the first electrode is configured to stimulate a HGN of the subject and the second electrode is configured to stimulate a PN of the subject. The system does not require the detection and classification of an apneic event or hypopnea event, but rather commands a first electrode to stimulate the HGN to treat OSA and commands a second electrode to deliver an inspiration stimulation signal to stimulate the PN for treating CSA by driving a respiration pace for the subject. The first electrode is commanded to deliver the stimulation signal to stimulate the HGN according to the respiration pace driven by the inspiration stimulation signal.
first_claim: 1. A system for treatment of Central Sleep Apnea (CSA) and Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA) in a subject, comprising: an implantable pulse generator (IPG) coupled to a first electrode and a second electrode, wherein the first electrode is configured to stimulate a hypoglossal nerve (HGN) of the subject and the second electrode is configured to stimulate a phrenic nerve (PN) of the subject; and a controller comprising a processor and memory, communicatively linked to the IPG and configured to: command the first electrode to deliver a stimulation signal to stimulate the HGN which innervates an upper airway muscle for alleviating an obstruction caused by OSA, and command the second electrode to continuously deliver an inspiration stimulation signal to stimulate the PN on a duty cycle for treating CSA by proactively driving a respiration pace for the subject, wherein the first electrode is commanded to deliver the stimulation signal to stimulate the HGN according to the respiration pace driven by the inspiration stimulation signal.
assignees: The Alfred E. Mann Foundation for Scientific Research

title: Methods and systems for magnetic stimulation
abstract: Methods and systems for magnetic stimulation are described. In some examples, a coil assembly for magnetic stimulation includes a winding block, a coil in the winding block, and a casing enclosing the winding block. The winding block is mounted to the casing only at one or more acoustic nodes of the winding block. The one or more acoustic nodes are identified as points in the winding block having minimal amplitude of vibrations when mechanically excited.
first_claim: 1. A coil assembly for transcranial magnetic stimulation, the coil assembly comprising: a winding block; a coil in the winding block; and a casing enclosing the winding block, wherein the winding block is mounted to the casing at two or more acoustic nodes of the winding block that are subject to a minimal vibration during a transcranial magnetic stimulation pulse, and wherein the winding block is mounted to the casing by one or more rubber grommets and nylon bolts at the respective acoustic node, wherein each of the acoustic nodes is identified as point in the winding block having minimal amplitude of vibrations while the coil is mechanically excited during the magnetic stimulation pulse.

title: Methods and Systems for Translation of Neural Activity into Embodied Digital-Avatar Animation
abstract: Methods of assisting individuals with communication are provided. In the disclosed methods, cortical activity from a region of the brain associated with movement, speech production, and/or language perception is recorded while an individual attempts to perform an action (e.g., to say words, express an emotion, perform a movement, etc.). Deep learning computational models are used to detect and decode the attempted action from the recorded brain activity. Decoding of actions from brain activity may be aided by the use of self-supervised machine learning techniques, which discretize each action into one or more action representations that serve as an effective intermediary for decoding neural activity patterns and features into meaningful action outputs. Methods for synthesizing decoded actions into audio and/or visual stimuli are also provided, allowing for more naturalistic and expressive communication for individuals who are unable to speak or experience other mobility limitations that inhibit full embodied communication.
first_claim: 1. A method of assisting a subject with communication, the method comprising: positioning a neural recording device comprising an electrode at a location in a sensorimotor cortex region of the brain of the subject to record brain electrical signal data associated with attempted speech by the subject; positioning an interface in communication with a computing device at a location on the head of the subject, wherein the interface is connected to the neural recording device; recording the brain electrical signal data associated with attempted speech by the subject using the neural recording device, wherein the interface receives the brain electrical signal data from the neural recording device and transmits the brain electrical signal data to a processor of the computing device; and decoding one or more speech sounds from the recorded brain electrical signal data using the processor, wherein the processor is programmed to use a machine learning model for the decoding.
assignees: The Regents of the University of California

title: THERAPEUTIC ULTRASOUND METHODS
abstract: Provided herein methods of treating diseases or disorders, particularly primary brain cancers, brain metastases, and other cancers, as well as inflammatory disorders, by directly insonating tissues with low-frequency ultrasound.
first_claim: 1. A method of treating a subject suffering from a primary cancer of a brain, said method comprising directly irradiating the cancerous lesion or non-resected tumor margins in a post-operative cavity with ultrasound having a frequency of between 20 and 200 kHz, at an ultrasound intensity of between 1 and 50 W/cm2, and wherein said ultrasound intensity is characterized by a thermal index (TI) value of between 0.1 than 5 and a low-frequency mechanical index (LFMI) value between 0.15 than 3.
assignees: B.G. NEGEV TECHNOLOGIES AND APPLICATIONS LTD.

title: Systems and methods for stimulating two or more nerve branches
abstract: Disclosed herein are devices, systems, and methods for treating a medical condition through a coordinated stimulation of two or more target nerves. In some embodiments, the stimulation comprises electrical stimulation delivered to a patient. In some embodiments, the coordinated stimulation comprises the two or more target nerves being stimulated in parallel, in series, a combination thereof, or any coordinated temporal sequence. In some embodiments, the stimulation delivery is contingent on an electrode placement confirmation via one or more electrode monitors. In some embodiments, the delivered electrical stimulation comprises one or more stimulation parameters configured to be adjusted based on feedback from the patient. In some embodiments, the one or more stimulation parameters are automatically randomized over a normal distribution.
first_claim: 1. A method of stimulating a plurality of target nerves in a subject to treat a medical condition, wherein the medical condition is one or more of ischemic stroke, cerebral brain damage due to ischemic stroke, hemorrhagic stroke, cerebral brain damage due to hemorrhagic stroke, a reperfusion injury, the method comprising: transcutaneously delivering a first stimulation energy to a supraorbital branch of a trigeminal nerve; transcutaneously delivering a second stimulation energy to an auricular branch of a vagal nerve; wherein the first and second stimulation energies are delivered in combination to treat the medical condition so that the first and second stimulation energies are delivered at a first ratio of first to second stimulation energy for a first time period, wherein the first and second stimulation energies are delivered at a second ratio of first to second stimulation energy for a second time period, wherein the first and second ratios are different, and wherein the second time period is after the first time period; and measuring an oxygenation level of the subject.

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS TO PLACE ONE OR MORE LEADS IN TISSUE FOR PROVIDING FUNCTIONAL AND/OR THERAPEUTIC STIMULATION
abstract: Systems and methods make possible the placement of one or more electrode leads in a tissue region for providing functional and/or therapeutic stimulation to tissue. The systems and methods are adapted to provide the relief of pain.
first_claim: 1. A method to alleviate pain comprising: placing at least one electrode within a targeted muscle; applying electrical stimulation through the at least one electrode; and activating a peripheral nerve that innervates a painful region by the electrical stimulation applied through the at least one electrode to alleviate pain in the painful region without damaging the peripheral nerve.

title: MUSCLE STIMULATION DEVICE
abstract: A system includes a remote control and a stimulation device with a pulse generator. The stimulation device is configured to receive data from the remote control associated with providing electrical stimulation, determine, based at least in part on the data, a setting associated with providing the electrical stimulation, and generate, based at least in part on the setting and via the pulse generator, electrical pulses to provide the electrical stimulation.
first_claim: 1. A system comprising: a case including: a first receptacle, a second receptacle, a third receptacle, first connector pins disposed within the first receptacle, second connector pins disposed within the second receptacle, third connector pins disposed within the third receptacle, first connectors disposed within the first receptacle, second connectors disposed within the second receptacle, and a radio-frequency identification; a first stimulation device to be disposed within the first receptacle, the first stimulation device including: a button, a light ring disposed around the button of the first stimulation device, connectors, wherein individual connectors of the first stimulation device engage with individual connectors of the first connectors, connector pads, wherein a portion of the connector pads of the first stimulation device engage with individual connector pins of the first connector pins, and a pulse generator; a second stimulation device configured to be disposed within the second receptacle, the second stimulation device including: a button, a light ring disposed around the button of the second stimulation device, connectors, wherein individual connectors of the second stimulation device engage with individual connectors of the second connectors, connector pads, wherein a portion of the connector pads of the second stimulation device engage with individual connector pins of the second connector pins, and a pulse generator; and a remote control disposed within the third receptacle, the remote control including connector pads, wherein a portion of the connector pads of the remote control engage with individual connector pins of the third connector pins.

title: Therapy Device
abstract: Embodiments disclosed herein describe an optical and magnetic stimulation, OMS, wound therapy device comprising: a light source configured to generate an optical field for an OMS wound therapy; an electric circuit coupled to the light source for driving the light source to generate the optical field; a coil configured to generate a magnetic field for the OMS wound therapy; and a magnetic field shield arranged between the coil on the one hand and the light source and electric circuit on the other hand, and wherein the magnetic field shield is configured to shield the electric circuit and the light source from the magnetic field generated by the coil.
first_claim: 1. An optical and magnetic stimulation, OMS, device comprising: a light source configured to generate an optical field, wherein the optical field comprises a wavelength of light for inducing an increase in reactive oxygen species, ROS.

title: Task Scheduling Method and Related Apparatus for Same
abstract: Embodiments of this disclosure provide a task scheduling method and a related apparatus for same. An apparatus for implementing the task scheduling method may be an electronic device including a GPU and a display screen, such as a mobile phone or a tablet computer. Through implementation of the foregoing method, the electronic device can identify a task type of a GPU task, an application to which the GPU task belongs, and a current system scene, and flexibly adjust, from a system level, a GPU processing priority of each GPU task based on a type of the GPU task, a scene in which the GPU task is located, or the like, instead of determining the GPU processing priority of each GPU task based only on a GPU processing priority preset by an application program, to avoid frame freezing problems such as frame freezing of home screen display.
first_claim: 1. A task scheduling method, applied to an electronic device, wherein the method comprises: receiving a first operation of a user; starting a first application in response to the first operation; performing, during running of the first application, a first GPU task created by the first application; receiving a second operation of the user; exiting from the first application to a home screen application in response to the second operation; and in a process of exiting from the first application to the home screen application, suspending the first GPU task and performing a second GPU task created by the home screen application; and wherein the second GPU task is a rendering task.

title: LIVE MIGRATION OF A VIRTUAL MACHINE EXECUTING WORKLOADS ON A GPU
abstract: A virtual machine (VM) that is executing workloads on a GPU is live migrated from a source host computer to a destination host computer. The live migration includes the steps of: while the VM is executing on the source host computer, selectively reading cold data from a frame buffer of the GPU and transferring the selectively read cold data to the destination host computer and then iteratively transferring contents of a system memory of the VM to the destination host computer; suspending the execution of the VM on the source host computer; and while the execution of the VM on the first host computer is suspended, reading remaining data to be transferred from the frame buffer and transferring the remaining data read from the frame buffer and contents of the modified portions of the system memory to the destination host computer.
first_claim: 1. A computer system comprising: a first host computer on which a virtual machine (VM) is executing, the first host computer having a first hardware platform including a physical central processing unit (CPU), a physical graphics processing unit (GPU), and physical memory resources, and the VM including a virtual CPU provisioned from the physical CPU, a system memory allocated for the virtual CPU from the physical memory resources, a virtual GPU associated with the physical GPU, and a frame buffer allocated for the virtual GPU from the physical memory resources; a second host computer having a second hardware platform including a physical CPU, a physical GPU, and physical memory resources; and computer software executing on the first and second host computers, the computer software implementing a method for migrating the VM to the second host computer, the method comprising: while the VM is executing on the first host computer, selectively reading cold data from the frame buffer and transferring the selectively read cold data from the physical memory resources of the first host computer to the physical memory resources of the second host computer, and then iteratively transferring contents of the system memory from the physical memory resources of the first host computer to the physical memory resources of the second host computer, and tracking portions of the system memory that are modified since the contents thereof were transferred, wherein said iteratively transferring includes a first step of transferring the entire contents of the system memory from the physical memory resources of the first host computer to the physical memory resources of the second host computer and one or more subsequent steps of transferring the contents of the modified portions of the system memory from the physical memory resources of the first host computer to the physical memory resources of the second host computer; suspending the execution of the VM on the first host computer; and while the execution of the VM on the first host computer is suspended, reading remaining data to be transferred from the frame buffer and transferring the remaining data read from the frame buffer and the contents of the modified portions of the system memory, from the physical memory resources of the first host computer to the physical memory resources of the second host computer.

title: Method and Apparatus for Improving the Scalability of GPU Architecture
abstract: The present invention relates to the technical field of high-performance computing and provides a method and apparatus for improving the scalability of GPU architecture. A system-level common module splits a total workload into a plurality of first-level workloads and distributes the first-level workloads to corresponding super scalable groups; an SSG common module of each super scalable group splits the first-level workloads into a plurality of second-level workloads and distributes the second-level workloads to corresponding SPCs, such that each SPC processes the received second-level workload. By dividing multi-level common modules, the present invention simplifies the hardware implementation of GPU, reduces the pressure on the common modules and on the connections between the common modules and each SPC, thereby breaking through the scalability and performance bottlenecks of GPU, and significantly improving the scalability of GPU systems.
first_claim: 1. A method for improving the scalability of GPU architecture, comprising: splitting, by a system-level common module, a total workload into a plurality of first-level workloads and distributing the first-level workloads to corresponding super scalable groups; and splitting, by an SSG common module of each super scalable group, the first-level workloads into a plurality of second-level workloads and distributing the second-level workloads to corresponding SPCs, such that each SPC processes the received second-level workload.

title: Hardware-accelerated nearest neighbor queries for arbitrary data primitives
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques to perform a K-nearest-neighbor query. In at least one embodiment, a set of bounding boxes corresponding to a set of primitives is generated that allows the query to be solved using light transport simulation acceleration features of a GPU.
first_claim: 1. A system, comprising: at least one processor; and at least one memory comprising instructions that, in response to execution by the at least one processor, cause the system to at least: identify, via a nearest neighbor query, a set of primitives that correspond to a query point; obtain a set of bounding boxes for the set of primitives; and modify, using ray tracing hardware, the set of bounding boxes to determine one or more bounding boxes in the set of bounding boxes that enclose the query point.

title: DEPLOYING DIGITAL AVATARS
abstract: Disclosed are systems and techniques for configuring multi-modal digital avatar (DA) resources. The techniques include selecting a plurality of multi-modal DA resources identifying, for a first multi-modal DA resource of the plurality of multi-modal DA resources, at least a first modal input event and a second modal input event, and generating a graph that defines an execution flow for the plurality of multi-modal DA resources. The graph includes nodes comprising a first node associated with a first DA resource, a second node associated with a second multi-modal DA resource, and a third node associated with a third multi-modal DA resource. The graph includes a plurality of directed edges, including a first directional edge associated with a transition of the execution flow from the first node to the second node conditioned on an event handler of the first node responding to an occurrence of the first modal input event.
first_claim: 1. A computer-implemented method including: selecting a plurality of multi-modal digital avatar resources that individually program a respective episode of interaction between a user and a computing device; identifying, for individual multi-modal digital avatar resources, a plurality of modal input events that can occur during a digital avatar interaction; generating a graph that defines an execution flow for the plurality of multi-modal digital avatar resources, the graph including: a plurality of nodes individually corresponding to a multi-modal digital avatar resource of the plurality of multi-modal digital avatar resources, and a plurality of directional edges connecting the plurality of nodes, the directional edges individually defining a conditional transition from a first node to a second node based at least on a modal input event corresponding to the first node; generating and executing a multi-modal digital avatar resource bundle based at least on the graph to cause the computing device to: detect a modal input event from the user during the digital avatar interaction; determine, using a current node of the graph, to respond to the detected modal input event; and transition execution from the current node to another node connected to the current node by one of the directional edges.

title: Dynamic Hierarchical Workload-Driven Control of Frequency Utilization Applicable to a System-on-Chip (SOC) Environment
abstract: Modern computing systems dynamically adjust hardware operation points to balance performance against power and thermal limitations. However, purely reactive power and thermal mitigation mechanisms can respond too slowly to sudden workload demands or prematurely throttle processing speeds based on static safety thresholds. To address these issues, a hierarchical, multi-time-scale control architecture can decouple high-speed, proactive workload-driven scaling from slower, reactive physical constraint scaling. In example implementations, an apparatus obtains a workload demand for a hardware subsystem and uses a fast control loop to generate a first candidate operation point. The apparatus also obtains physical operating parameters and uses a slower control loop to generate a second candidate operation point. The apparatus then arbitrates between multiple candidate operation points to select an execution operation point, proactively prioritizing the first candidate operation point. This architecture decreases execution latency for bursty workloads while safely enforcing physical boundaries and protecting hardware reliability.
first_claim: 1. An apparatus comprising: at least one memory comprising processor-executable instructions; and one or more processors configured to execute the processor-executable instructions to cause the apparatus to perform operations comprising: obtaining at least one workload demand associated with a workload executing on a hardware subsystem; generating, by a first control loop operating at a first time scale, a first candidate operation point based on the at least one workload demand; obtaining one or more physical operating parameters associated with the hardware subsystem; generating, by a second control loop operating at a second time scale that is slower than the first time scale, a second candidate operation point based on the one or more physical operating parameters; arbitrating between multiple candidate operation points comprising at least the first candidate operation point and the second candidate operation point to select an execution operation point, including prioritizing the first candidate operation point over the second candidate operation point; and applying the execution operation point to the hardware subsystem.

title: Dynamic graphical processing unit register allocation
abstract: Systems, apparatuses, and methods for dynamic graphics processing unit (GPU) register allocation are disclosed. A GPU includes at least a plurality of compute units (CUs), a control unit, and a plurality of registers for each CU. If a new wavefront requests more registers than are currently available on the CU, the control unit spills registers associated with stack frames at the bottom of a stack since they will not likely be used in the near future. The control unit has complete flexibility determining how many registers to spill based on dynamic demands and can prefetch the upcoming necessary fills without software involvement. Effectively, the control unit manages the physical register file as a cache. This allows younger workgroups to be dynamically descheduled so that older workgroups can allocate additional registers when needed to ensure improved fairness and better forward progress guarantees.
first_claim: 1. An apparatus comprising: a control unit comprising circuitry configured to: monitor, during execution of wavefronts during a first scheduling period, a value indicative of register thrashing associated with wavefront register values that are spilled to a memory in response to a wavefront requiring more registers than are available in a register file; and reduce a number of wavefronts permitted to be dispatched for at least a portion of a second scheduling period subsequent to the first scheduling period, responsive to the value exceeding a threshold.

title: RESOURCE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
abstract: Systems and methods involve for a selection of a policy for resource allocation, retrieving a configuration priority for the selected policy; determining a destination storage system for the retrieved configuration priority; determining provisioned capacity of the destination storage system. For the provisioned capacity exceeding a reserve capacity of the destination storage system, they can further include retrieving a next configuration priority for the selected policy for when the destination storage system has insufficient capacity for the configuration priority, or for when the destination storage system cannot satisfy minimum reserve capacities of other policies should requested capacity be allocated for the configuration priority; and allocating the requested capacity for the selected policy for when the destination storage system has sufficient capacity for the configuration priority and for when the destination storage system can satisfy minimum reserve capacities of the other policies should the requested capacity be allocated for the configuration priority.
first_claim: 1. A method, comprising: for a selection of a policy for resource allocation: retrieving a configuration priority for the selected policy; determining a destination storage system for the retrieved configuration priority; and determining provisioned capacity of the destination storage system; for the provisioned capacity exceeding a reserve capacity of the destination storage system: retrieving a next configuration priority for the selected policy for when the destination storage system has insufficient capacity for the configuration priority, or for when the destination storage system cannot satisfy minimum reserve capacities of other policies should requested capacity be allocated for the configuration priority; and allocating the requested capacity for the selected policy for when the destination storage system has sufficient capacity for the configuration priority and for when the destination storage system can satisfy minimum reserve capacities of the other policies should the requested capacity be allocated for the configuration priority.

title: ENVOY FOR MULTI-TENANT COMPUTE INFRASTRUCTURE
abstract: A data management and storage (DMS) cluster of peer DMS nodes manages data of a tenant of a multi-tenant compute infrastructure. The compute infrastructure includes an envoy connecting the DMS cluster to virtual machines of the tenant executing on the compute infrastructure. The envoy provides the DMS cluster with access to the virtual tenant network and the virtual machines of the tenant connected via the virtual tenant network for DMS services such as data fetch jobs to generate snapshots of the virtual machines. The envoy sends the snapshot from the virtual machine to a peer DMS node via the connection for storage within the DMS cluster. The envoy provides the DMS cluster with secure access to authorized tenants of the compute infrastructure while maintaining data isolation of tenants within the compute infrastructure.
first_claim: 1. A method, comprising: deploying an envoy in a multi-tenant cloud compute infrastructure, the multi-tenant cloud compute infrastructure hosting a first virtual machine; wherein: the envoy comprises a second virtual machine; the first and second virtual machines are part of a plurality of virtual machines allocated to a tenant in the multi-tenant cloud compute infrastructure; and the second virtual machine is connected with the plurality of virtual machines of the tenant including the first virtual machine via a virtual network of the tenant; and wherein: the virtual network is hosted by the multi-tenant cloud compute infrastructure; the multi-tenant cloud compute infrastructure isolates the virtual network of the tenant from other tenants of the multi-tenant cloud compute infrastructure and restricts access to the virtual network and the virtual machines of the tenant and to an infrastructure network connecting physical machines including a physical machine that hosts one or more virtual machines of the tenant; and the infrastructure network and the virtual network use different network layers and share a physical layer; accessing, by the envoy, an interface of the multi-tenant cloud compute infrastructure to cause the multi-tenant cloud compute infrastructure to provide the envoy with data corresponding to a snapshot of the first virtual machine, the accessing comprising: transmitting, by the envoy, a request via the interface of the multi-tenant cloud compute infrastructure; and receiving, by the envoy, a response to the request, the response including the data corresponding to the snapshot of the first virtual machine provided by the multi-tenant cloud compute infrastructure; generating, by the envoy, the snapshot based on the response received by the envoy from the multi-tenant cloud compute infrastructure; establishing, by the envoy, a connection to an element of a data management and storage (DMS) system; and sending, by the envoy, the snapshot of the first virtual machine to the element of the DMS system.

title: Provisioning computing resources across computing platforms
abstract: This disclosure relates to resource allocation for workloads across computing environments and computing architectures. Computing resource usage of a workload is monitored, where the workload is executing on one or more processors of a first computing environment. One or more comparable workloads are identified based on the computing resource usage of the workload in the first environment. A suggested resource allocation for the workload in a second computing environment is generated based on characteristics of the one or more comparable workloads.
first_claim: 1. A method comprising: receiving a performance indicator of a workload executing on one or more processors of a first computing environment; identifying one or more comparable workloads based on the performance indicator of the workload in the first computing environment; generating a suggested resource allocation for the workload in a second computing environment based on characteristics of the one or more comparable workloads, the suggested resource allocation including suggested configurations for one or more additional instances of the workload at the second computing environment, the suggested resource allocation indicating whether an instance of the one or more additional instances is a spot instance, the characteristics comprising a number of I/O requests, usage pattern, resource usage, or combinations thereof; allocating one or more resources for the instance of the workload at the second computing environment; and creating, at the second computing environment and using the one or more allocated resources associated with the suggested resource allocation, the instance of the workload.

title: Data storage device and method for dynamic flash interface module (FIM) load balancing for memory die sharing
abstract: A data storage device can have a memory with one or more memory dies. The data storage device can also have one or more backend modules (e.g., flash interface modules (FIMs)) that send sense/transfer or program operations to the memory dies. In some situations, there can be more memory dies than FIMs. Using a fixed allocation between memory dies and FIMs in this situation can result in an inefficient pipeline of memory commands, where some FIMs are idle while other FIMs are busy. In one embodiment, the FIMs are dynamically allocated to the memory dies to provide a more-efficient workload distribution. Other embodiments are provided.
first_claim: 1. In a data storage device comprising a plurality of memory dies and a plurality of flash interface modules (FIMs), wherein there are more memory dies than FIMs, a method comprising: using a scheduler associated with a respective subset of FIMs to create a dynamic allocation between the respective subset of FIMs and at least some of the plurality of memory dies based on a workload of memory operations; and using a selector associated with a respective memory die of the plurality of memory dies and further associated with the respective subset of FIMs to provide the workload of memory operations to the respective subset of FIMs per the dynamic allocation; wherein the dynamic allocation more-evenly distributes the workload of memory operations among the plurality of FIMs than when a fixed allocation is used that fixedly allocates a FIM to more than one memory die.

title: SAFE INTERRUPT HANDLING
abstract: In various examples, systems and methods are disclosed that handle interrupts in a monolithic system. In particular, the embodiments of the present disclosure may implement separate memory regions for different interrupt handlers to execute based at least on criticality levels of interrupts. For example, in response to receiving an interrupt from a peripheral, the criticality level of the interrupt may be determined based at least on the criticality level of the peripheral. The execution memory region may be switched to the memory region corresponding to the criticality level, in which the interrupt handler performs one or more operations for the interrupt.
first_claim: 1. A method comprising: determining, from a set of criticality levels, a criticality level of an interrupt corresponding to a peripheral of a monolithic system; mapping a memory region associated with the peripheral to a memory protection domain corresponding to the criticality level; transitioning to the memory protection domain corresponding to the criticality level; executing, in the memory protection domain, an interrupt handler performing one or more time-critical operations associated with the interrupt; and scheduling non-time-critical operations associated with the interrupt for a deferred handler, configured to handle deferred operations, to perform.

title: GENERATING A DATA PIPELINE FROM MEDIA INPUT
abstract: Methods, apparatuses, and products for generating a data pipeline from media input, the method comprising: receiving, by a computing system, a media input comprising a representation of a data processing workflow; analyzing, by the computing system, the media input using one or more artificial intelligence models to detect a plurality of pipeline components; determining, by the computing system, an arrangement of the pipeline components based on relationships inferred from the media input; and generating, by the computing system, a data pipeline definition comprising the pipeline components and their arrangement for execution within a processing environment.
first_claim: 1. A computer-implemented method for generating a data pipeline from media input, comprising: receiving, by a computing system, a media input comprising a representation of a data processing workflow; analyzing, by the computing system, the media input using one or more artificial intelligence models to detect pipeline components; determining, by the computing system, an arrangement of the pipeline components based on relationships inferred from the media input; and generating, by the computing system, a data pipeline definition comprising the pipeline components and their arrangement for execution within a processing environment.

title: COORDINATION OF AGENTIC WORKFLOWS IN MULTI-AGENT ENVIRONMENTS
abstract: A disclosed agentic system includes a plurality of agents configured to coordinate control of a conversational interface based on transitions between a plurality of state machine states. Each of the states has a designated an agent control group comprising one or more agents selected from the plurality of agents that is responsible for acting on inputs received through the conversational interface while the state machine is in the state. The state machine is further defined by a plurality of permissible state transitions between pairs of the states, with each state-to-state transition being triggered by satisfaction of a different set of transition criteria. The plurality of agents are individually configured to evaluate the transition criteria and selectively transfer control of the conversational interface among the agent control groups defined for different states as state transitions are triggered by satisfaction of the transition criteria.
first_claim: 1. A method of providing a multi-agent workflow, the method including: receiving, through a programming interface, an indication of a plurality of agents configured to process and respond to natural language inputs received through a conversational interface: receiving, through the programming interface, state definitions for a plurality of states of a state machine, each of the state definitions identifying a select state of the plurality of states and designating an agent control group comprising one or more agents selected from the plurality of agents that is responsible for acting on inputs received through the conversational interface while the state machine is in the select state; receiving, through the programming interface, state transition definitions that each identify: a former state of the plurality of states that the state machine is operating in when a state transition occurs; a new state of the plurality of states that the state machine is operating in following the state transition; and transition criteria that, when satisfied, triggers the state transition; and initializing the plurality of agents within a runtime environment to selectively transfer control of the conversational interface among one another based on transitions between states of the state machine, the control of the conversational interface being transferred according to a flat control structure that lacks parent-child relationships between pairs of the plurality of agents.

title: Cognitive resource scheduling
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for cognitive resource scheduling for radar systems. Embodiments of the present disclosure demonstrate the implementation of a policy neural network to perform task scheduling, which offers superior performance to existing heuristic methods while maintaining feasible execution times to enable real-time implementation.
first_claim: 1. A radar system, comprising: a radar; a resource scheduling device, wherein the resource scheduling device is configured to: receive a plurality of tasks to schedule for the radar, wherein the plurality of tasks are associated with a plurality of parameters, determine respective priorities for each task in the plurality of tasks based on respective costs associated with scheduling each task, sort the tasks based on the determined priorities, generate a sequence of the tasks such that a combined cost of delaying and dropping the tasks is minimized, calculate respective positions of beams for a search lattice, randomize the positions, and load the positions into respective search queues; and a neural network configured to be trained based on generated sequences from the resource scheduling device, wherein the resource scheduling device is further configured to determine the respective priorities for each task in the plurality of tasks based on an output from the neural network.
assignees: The Government of the United States of America, as represented by the Secretary of the Navy

title: NEURAL NETWORK INFERENCING WITH TOKEN REUSE
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques to performing inferencing by one or more Large Language Models. In at least one embodiment, one or more tokens may be previously identified by one or more LLMs and the one or more tokens previously identified by the one or more LLMs may be caused to be reused by the one or more LLMs to perform inferencing.
first_claim: 1. A processor, comprising: one or more circuits to cause one or more large language models (LLMs) to perform inferencing for a prompt using one or more previously-used tokens identified by the one or more LLMs to be re-used based on a hash-based representation of the prompt and a hash-based representation of the one or more tokens.

title: MEMORY AUGMENTED LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL (LLM) CLASSIFICATION FRAMEWORK
abstract: Various embodiments of the present disclosure provide machine learning architectures and training approaches that improve the functionality of a computer in various aspects. The techniques comprise receiving, using a classification large language model (LLM), an input embedding corresponding to an input data object, generating, using the classification LLM, a contextual embedding, for a classification task, based on the input embedding, generating, using the classification LLM, a memory-augmented embedding by modifying the contextual embedding with a learned memory token specific to the classification task, and providing, using the classification LLM, a classification for the input data object based on the memory-augmented embedding.
first_claim: 1. A computer-implemented method comprising: receiving, by one or more processors and using a classification large language model (LLM), an input embedding corresponding to an input data object; generating, by the one or more processors and using the classification LLM, a contextual embedding, for a classification task, based on the input embedding; generating, by the one or more processors and using the classification LLM, a memory-augmented embedding by modifying the contextual embedding with a learned memory token specific to the classification task; and providing, by the one or more processors and using the classification LLM, a classification for the input data object based on the memory-augmented embedding.

title: MIXTURE OF EXPERTS MODELS WITH SPARSIFIED WEIGHTS
abstract: A method is presented for operating a machine learning model including one or more mixture of experts layers. The method comprises receiving one or more input data shards at a routing gate network for a mixture of experts layer comprising a plurality of neural network experts. One or more neural network experts in the mixture of experts layer is designated layer to evaluate each input data shard. For each designated neural network expert, a weight matrix is retrieved having a predetermined sparsity to generate a sparsified designated neural network expert. Each input data shard is evaluated with a respective sparsified designated neural network expert.
first_claim: 1. A method performed by a computing system for training a machine learning model including one or more mixture of experts layers, the method comprising: at a routing gate network for a mixture of experts layer that includes a plurality of neural network experts, receiving one or more input data shards related to a predictive modeling problem; applying coarse-grained sparsity to the mixture of experts layer to reduce a global sparsity level of the mixture of experts layer by designating one or more neural network experts as a subset of the plurality of neural network experts in the mixture of experts layer to train on each input data shard; applying fine-grained sparsity to the designated neural network experts to further reduce the global sparsity level of the mixture of experts layer by, for each designated neural network expert, retrieving a weight matrix having a predetermined sparsity to generate a sparsified designated neural network expert that has a set of one or more parameters including fewer parameters than the neural network expert from which the sparsified designated neural network expert was generated; performing a forward pass of each input data shard with a respective sparsified designated neural network expert to generate a prediction; performing backpropagation of each input data shard with the respective sparsified designated neural network expert to determine an error for the prediction; and updating the weight matrix having the predetermined sparsity based on the error.

title: DWELL TIME OPTIMIZATION SYSTEM
abstract: A dwell time optimization system is described. A method includes training a deep neural network (DNN) of a machine learning (ML) model to generate a predicted long dwell metric using a training sample from a training dataset, the training sample comprising a set of features and a target label, the set of features comprising video features associated with a video and entity features associated with an entity identifier (ID), the video features including a video length, and the target label comprising a binary value for a long dwell metric, wherein the binary value is set to a first binary value when a dwell time for the video is greater than or equal to an adaptive threshold value and a second binary value when the dwell time for the video is less than the adaptive threshold value. Other embodiments are described and claimed.
first_claim: 1. A method, comprising: training a deep neural network (DNN) of a machine learning (ML) model over a set of training iterations, wherein a training iteration comprises: retrieving a training sample from a training dataset, the training sample comprising a set of features and a target label, the set of features comprising video features associated with a video and entity features associated with an entity identifier (ID), the video features including a video length, and the target label comprising a value for a long dwell metric representing when a dwell time for the video is greater than or equal to an adaptive threshold value; generating a predicted long dwell metric from the set of features using the DNN; computing a loss value between the predicted long dwell metric and the long dwell metric using a loss function; and adjusting a set of model parameters for the DNN based on the loss value.

title: Large language model (LLM) guided robust learning system design for C2 detection
abstract: Various embodiments provide a system, method, and device for applying a C2 machine learning-based detection framework. The method incudes (i) generating a fuzzing based on a C2 machine-learning detection model using a large learning model for performing profile-based seed generation; and (ii) detecting C2 traffic using the C2 machine learning detection model.
first_claim: 1. A system for detecting C2 traffic, comprising: one or more processors configured to: generate a fuzzing based on a C2 machine learning (ML) detection model using a large language model (LLM) for performing profile-based seed generation, wherein the LLM is queried with (i) a profile suggestion obtained from a C2 framework fuzzing tool, and (ii) classification feedback from prior predictions of the C2 ML detection model to produce C2 configuration profiles that are generated based on a profile syntax and a format definition and used as seeds for the fuzzing tool; determine a code coverage for a set of existing profile seeds, wherein determining the code coverage includes monitoring a number of lines of code executed by a C2 configuration profile corresponding to a particular seed of the set of existing profile seeds; in response to determining, based at least in part on the code coverage, to generate a set of new seeds, cause the LLM to generate the set of new seeds to be used to retrain the C2 ML detection model; and detect C2 traffic using the C2 ML detection model, wherein detecting the C2 traffic comprises: obtaining a traffic sample; generating a tuple representation of header information in the traffic sample, the tuple comprising a header type identifier, an encoder type, and a length field; and determining header embeddings from the tuple and providing the header embeddings to a neural network to obtain a predicted traffic classification; and a memory coupled to the one or more processors and configured to provide the one or more processors with instructions.

title: Hybrid explainable artificial intelligence system
abstract: A hybrid explainable artificial intelligence system may include a shallow learning model and a deep learning model. The shallow learning model may be a machine learning system. The deep learning model may be a neural network. The system may input a data set into both the shallow learning model and the deep learning model. Both the shallow learning model and the deep learning model may produce an output. When there is a common output between the shallow learning model and the deep learning model, the process performed by the shallow learning model may be used to formulate an explanation of the process performed by the deep learning model. The explanation of the process performed by the deep learning model may be used to raise the sensitivity of one or more components of the data set. Such components may include a word or phrase within a transcript.
first_claim: 1. A method for generating explainable artificial-intelligence, the method comprising: inputting a data set into a shallow learning system, the shallow learning system comprising a single-layer predictor; inputting the data set into a deep learning system, the deep learning system comprising a multi-layer predictor; processing, at the shallow learning system, the data set into a feature set; processing, at the deep learning system, the data set into raw data; creating, at the deep learning system, from the raw data, a prediction set with multiple layers; mapping the prediction set against the feature set to identify to what extent each feature contributed to a final prediction from the prediction set; based on the mapping, generating an explanation of predictive behavior exhibited by the deep learning system; tracking correspondence between each layer of the deep learning system and the shallow learning system; analyzing changes in prediction sets as compared to feature sets for each layer of the deep learning system; reconfiguring the feature sets based on the analysis for each layer of the deep learning system; and using the feature sets, as reconfigured, to guide the deep learning system on a new training path limited to a specific layer within the deep learning system, wherein the system modifies parameters of neurons in the deep learning system.

title: SYSTEM FOR NOON DETECTION AND AUTOMATIC INTERPRETATION OF DETECTED LOGS BASED ON MACHINE LEARNING
abstract: This specification relates to a method for a system to perform true/false positive determination and automatic interpretation of a log, the method including: collecting the log related to a security event through a log collection module; preprocessing the log through a preprocessing module and constructing a behavior graph based on the preprocessed log; classifying the true/false positives of the log based on the log and the behavior graph through a machine learning module; and generating a corresponding message based on the classification of the true/false positives through a Large Language Model (LLM) module.
first_claim: 1. A method for a system to perform true/false positive determination and automatic interpretation of a log, the method comprising: collecting the log related to a security event through a log collection module; preprocessing the log through a preprocessing module and constructing a behavior graph based on the preprocessed log; classifying the true/false positives of the log based on the log and the behavior graph through a machine learning module; and generating a corresponding message based on the classification of the true/false positives through a Large Language Model (LLM) module.

title: Automated discovery and design process based on black-box optimization with mixed inputs
abstract: A method and system of optimizing a machine learning process includes receiving an input set of historical data including input values and output values. The historical data is incorporated into a sampling design to form the initial dataset. A surrogate model of the machine learning model is generated by fitting the historical data using a rectified linear activation function (ReLU) deep neural network. Mixed-integer linear programming techniques are applied to the surrogate model to arrive at a set of predicted optimal inputs. The machine learning model is tested using the predicted optimal inputs. Output from the testing of the machine learning model is generated using the predicted optimal inputs. A determination from the output is made as to whether an optimal output has been generated by the testing of the machine learning model using the predicted optimal inputs.
first_claim: 1. A computer-implemented method, comprising: receiving historical data including a first set of input values and a first set of output values; incorporating the received historical data into a sampling design to form an initial dataset comprising function values and continuous values; normalizing the initial dataset; training, based on the normalized initial dataset, a feedforward deep neural network with a softplus activation function to determine a solution point; training a rectified linear activation function (ReLU) deep neural network using the determined solution point as an initial point; generating a surrogate model of a machine learning model based on the training of the ReLU deep neural network; applying one or more mixed-integer linear programming techniques to the surrogate model such that a second set of predicted input values is determined, the mixed-integer linear programming techniques including domain knowledge-based constraints; testing the machine learning model, from which the surrogate model is generated, using the second set of predicted input values as input to the machine learning model such that, in response, the machine learning model generates a second set of output values, wherein the testing of the machine learning model comprises determining whether an output value, among the second set of output values, has been generated, and the output value is based on an undefined black-box function of the first set of input values; and testing a sample that incorporates the second set of output values.

title: LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS TRAINING DATA FILTERING
abstract: An embodiment includes sampling form sample domain data, representative of data pertaining to a domain, wherein the sample domain data comprises a set of documents. The embodiment includes establishing, a statistical distribution of the set of documents according to a readability metric of each document in the set of documents based on the domain. The embodiment includes causing the machine learning model to output a performance metric. The embodiment includes modifying, the machine learning model. The embodiment includes filtering, the subset of documents from the sample domain data such that a second subset comprising documents remaining in the sample domain data after the extracting comprises filtered data. The embodiment also includes adjusting of a parameter of the machine learning model based at least on a difference between the sample domain data and a previous sample domain data.
first_claim: 1. A computer-implemented method comprising: executing, a specially purposed sampling instruction by a domain sampling component, causing sampling of raw data to form sample domain data, wherein the sample domain data comprises a set of documents; establishing, a statistical distribution of the set of documents, according to a readability metric of each document in the set of documents based on a domain; configuring, a computational component to operate with a machine learning model causing the machine learning model to iteratively execute a specially purposed training instruction on the sample domain data, the executing outputting a performance metric; modifying, the machine learning model responsive to the performance metric being compared to a performance threshold, wherein the performance threshold is based on a benchmark dataset; capturing, from the statistical distribution, a subset of documents such that each member of the subset has a value of a corresponding readability metric, and the value is below a first threshold configured for the statistical distribution; filtering, the subset of documents from the sample domain data such that a second subset comprising documents remaining in the sample domain data after the filtering comprises filtered data; and further configuring the computational component to cause adjustment of a parameter of the machine learning model based at least on a difference between the filtered data and a previous sample domain data.

title: Dynamic neural distribution function machine learning architecture
abstract: The present disclosure discusses dynamic supervised learning (DSL) and dynamic neural distribution function (DNDF) machine learning architectures and platforms. In contrast to existing ML approaches, DNDF accommodates a whole data structure via a neural network distribution function from which a decision boundary is born out. In particular, a neural network learning algorithm is used to extract a decision boundary while a neural distribution function is a neural data distribution approach wherein one or more decision boundaries are extracted among various distributions. Other aspects may be described and/or claimed.
first_claim: 1. One or more non-transitory computer-readable media (NTCRM) comprising instructions for a dynamic neural distribution function learning algorithm, wherein execution of the instructions by one or more processors of a compute node is to cause the compute node to: operate a machine learning algorithm to learn a set of neural distribution functions (NDFs) independently of one another; and during each iteration of a learning process until convergence is reached, provide each NDF in the set of NDFs with an input pattern to obtain a set of candidate outputs, wherein each NDF is configured to generate a candidate output in the set of candidate outputs based on the input pattern; operate a competition function to select a candidate output from among the set of candidate outputs; compare the selected candidate output with a target pattern to obtain an error value; adjust the neural gains of corresponding NDFs in the set of NDFs when the error value is greater than a threshold value; and feed the adjusted neural gains to the corresponding NDFs for generation of a next set of candidate outputs during a next iteration of the learning process.

title: Systems and Methods for Fine-Tuning Generative Models for Detecting the Relevance of Content Items
abstract: Systems and methods for fine-tuning a generative model for detecting the relevance of content items are provided. The method includes receiving, by a computing system, a website identifier associated with a web resource; extracting, by the computing system, a plurality of assets from the web resource based on the website identifier; generating, by a first machine-learning model operating on the computing system, a summarization of the web resource based on the plurality of assets; processing, by a second machine-learning model operating on the computing system, the summarization of the web resource to generate a content item; and processing, by a large language model (LLM) operating on the computing system, the content item to generate a binary content score based on the summarization of the web resource.
first_claim: 1. A computer-implemented method, comprising: receiving, by a computing system, a website identifier associated with a web resource; extracting, by the computing system, a plurality of assets from the web resource based on the website identifier; generating, by a first machine-learning model operating on the computing system, a summarization of the web resource based on the plurality of assets; processing, by a second machine-learning model operating on the computing system, the summarization of the web resource to generate a content item; and processing, by a large language model (LLM) operating on the computing system, the content item to generate a binary content score based on the summarization of the web resource.

title: On-the-fly deep learning in machine learning at autonomous machines
abstract: A mechanism is described for facilitating the transfer of features learned by a user-independent pre-trained deep neural network to a user-dependent neural network. The mechanism includes extracting a feature learned by a first deep neural network (DNN) model via the framework, wherein the first DNN model is a pre-trained DNN model for computer vision to enable user-independent classification of an object within an input video frame and training, via the deep learning framework, a second DNN model for computer vision based on the extracted feature, the second DNN model an update of the first DNN model, wherein training the second DNN model includes training the second DNN model based on a dataset including user-dependent data.
first_claim: 1. A data processing system on a computing device, the data processing system comprising: one or more storage devices comprising a graphics execution environment including instructions to provide a deep learning framework to accelerate deep learning operations via one or more general-purpose graphics processors of the computing device, the deep learning framework to cause the one or more general-purpose graphics processors to perform operations comprising: extracting, via the deep learning framework, a feature vector learned by a first deep neural network (DNN) model, wherein the first DNN model is a pre-trained DNN model for computer vision to enable user-independent classification of an object within an input video frame and the feature vector is a computer-vision feature vector; and training, via the deep learning framework, a second DNN model for computer vision based on the extracted feature vector and a dataset including user-dependent data, the second DNN model an update of the first DNN model, wherein the deep learning framework is to provide machine learning primitives accelerated via instructions executed by the one or more general-purpose graphics processors, and training the second DNN model includes executing one or more primitives provided by the deep learning framework to cause the one or more general-purpose graphics processors to perform operations to train the second DNN model based on the extracted feature vector and the dataset including the user-dependent data.

title: OPTIMIZING TRAINING OF MACHINE LEARNING MODELS WITH FINE-GRAINED LABELS
abstract: Systems and methods for optimizing training of machine learning models with fine-grained labels. Bounding boxes of detected entities within a scene obtained from images can be generated with an open vocabulary model. Clipped entities can be generated based on pixel-wise information of the detected entities obtained within the bounding boxes with a segmentation model. Fine-grained labels for the detected entities can be determined based on the clipped entities and predetermined labels from datasets with a self-supervised transformer model. An augmented dataset can be generated with the fine-grained labels to retrain a machine learning model to perform downstream tasks.
first_claim: 1.
