A method, comprising: generating bounding boxes of detected entities within a scene obtained from images with an open vocabulary model; generating clipped entities based on pixel-wise information of the detected entities obtained within the bounding boxes with a segmentation model; determining fine-grained labels for the detected entities based on the clipped entities and predetermined labels from datasets with a self-supervised transformer model; and generating an augmented dataset with the fine-grained labels to retrain a machine learning model to perform downstream tasks.

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR BUILDING AI AGENTS USING REASONING LANGUAGE MODELS
abstract: A method for building an artificial intelligence (AI) agent is provided. The method includes obtaining a training dataset including a training query and a groundtruth answer; generating a training output including a reasoning portion subject to a first generative budget and a solution portion that results from the reasoning portion subject to a second generative budget; assigning a reward based on a comparison between the solution portion and the groundtruth answer; and updating parameters of a first neural network based language model based on a gradient of an expected return based on the reward. The method also includes: iteratively refining the training output while maintaining the training output under a total generative budget; generating a reasoning that arrives at a final solution, wherein the reasoning is subject to a user defined generative budget; and building, at a server the AI agent employing a trained first neural network based language model.
first_claim: 1. A method for building an artificial intelligence (AI) agent, comprising: obtaining a training dataset including a training query and a groundtruth answer; generating, by a first neural network based language model, a training output including a reasoning portion subject to a first generative budget and a solution portion that results from the reasoning portion subject to a second generative budget, in response to the training query; assigning a reward, by a second neural network based language model, based on a comparison between the solution portion and the groundtruth answer; updating parameters of the first neural network based language model based on a gradient of an expected return based on the reward over a period of time; iteratively refining, by the updated first neural network based language model, the training output while maintaining the training output under a total generative budget; generating, by the trained first neural network based language model, a reasoning that arrives at a final solution to a user query, wherein the reasoning is subject to a user defined generative budget; and building, at a server the AI agent employing a trained first neural network based language model.

title: DISCOVERING COMPUTER PROGRAMS USING LANGUAGE MODEL NEURAL NETWORKS
abstract: Systems and methods for searching through a space of candidate computer programs for performing a task to determine a final computer program that includes information of how to perform the task (i.e., steps and processes to accomplish a task).
first_claim: 1. A method performed by a computer system comprising one or more computers, the method comprising: receiving specification data specifying a task; initializing a program database of candidate computer programs for performing the task, wherein each candidate computer program in the database is associated with a respective set of one or more evaluation scores that each measures a respective performance dimension of the candidate computer program on the task; performing a search to update the program database, wherein performing the search comprises: repeatedly performing respective candidate generation operations for each of a plurality of language model neural networks, the respective operations for each language model neural network comprising: selecting a plurality of candidate computer programs from the database using the respective sets of one or more evaluation scores for the candidate computer programs in the database; generating an input prompt for the language model neural network from the selected candidate computer programs; and processing the input prompt using the language model neural network to generate one or more new candidate computer programs; and repeatedly performing evaluation operations comprising: identifying, using a set of one or more evaluator devices, one or more new candidate computer programs that are not associated with evaluation scores; applying, using the set of one or more evaluator devices, a set of one or more evaluation functions for the task to each of the identified new candidate computer programs to determine a set of one or more evaluation scores for the new candidate computer program that each measures a respective performance dimension of the new candidate computer program on the task; adding the new candidate computer program to the database of candidate computer programs; and associating the new candidate computer program with the set of one or more evaluation scores for the new candidate computer program in the database; and after performing the search, selecting one of the candidate computer programs from the database as a final computer program for performing the task using the respective sets of one or more evaluation scores for the candidate computer programs in the database.
